status: review-draft; reconciled to R01 consumer 0.2; no live provider validation

scope.runtime: user-owned environment; ChatGPT desktop Work project is the selected product surface, not proof of local execution
scope.moai_server: authentication, course entitlement, device/license state only; never a KIS proxy or financial-data store
scope.transport: FastMCP 4.1.3 over official MCP Python SDK 2.3.0; user-local stdio; 2026-07-28 stable MCP protocol; WebSocket and remote HTTP deferred

security.credential_source: user-owned OS secure store; .goose contains non-secret references only (recommendation pending user confirmation)
security.token_storage: process memory only; no disk cache, logs, prompt or report
security.account_identifier: opaque account_ref resolved only inside the user runtime
security.cache_default: disabled; cache TTL and freshness budget are separate controls
security.model_context: send only minimum normalized facts; account raw payload is local to the adapter and is not fanned out to specialist prompts
security.live_network_default: disabled by policy; market rights false; account read false
security.transport_protection: HTTPS certificate verification enabled; exact KIS host/path allowlist; redirects rejected; no retries; bounded response size
security.account_read_status: not exposed until local account resolution, response-field mapping and explicit consent UX are implemented
security.market_rights_gate_semantics: market_rights_enabled=false and rights_pending are conservative prototype configuration defaults, not a finding that KIS prohibits a single individual from using quote data locally for their own assets
security.rights_evidence: provider basis must be purpose-scoped and cited; technical configuration does not create provider or exchange permission

provenance.api_reference: static catalog function/endpoint/TR mapping ID; no secret
provenance.source_as_of: source or market observation time, nullable if provider does not return it
provenance.rights_status: approved only when an explicit purpose-specific decision and basis are recorded; pending is the default when only a technical policy allows the call; blocked when purpose is disallowed
provenance.partial: boolean derived from field availability; missing data is not zero
provenance.stale: boolean|null; null when freshness budget/calendar is unknown
provenance.provider_api_version: provider version or explicit unknown; do not substitute code catalog commit
provenance.received_at: local provider-response receipt observation in UTC
provenance.available_at: time available to the local runtime in UTC
provenance.supersedes: provider revision/document identifier replaced or null
provenance.report_cutoff: report snapshot cutoff or null when not supplied to the tool
provenance.clock_basis: which clock/event was used for each timestamp

common_envelope.warnings: array of safe, non-secret diagnostic codes

NumericFact.value: decimal string, never binary float for financial arithmetic

Quote.previous_close: unsupported in the current registered quote output; absent from outputSchema; never infer from last and change
Quote.source_field_values: bounded unmapped provider fields; no unsupported interpretation
Quote.null_reasons: normalized field → safe reason code; never replace with 0
Quote.field_lineage: per normalized field: provider/API version, endpoint, tool, parameter schema, raw path/unit/sign, transform, nullable reason, pagination, entitlement, fixture ID, and verification status

FlowObservation.flow_class: provider-defined category; do not infer KR↔US equivalence

Headline.title: plain text title only
Headline.article_url: only when provider supplies and rights permit it; otherwise null

AccountSnapshot.account_ref: opaque local reference, never CANO or full account

The product report set is being reorganized around common investor tasks; prior 23 routes and previous 14+3 baseline are historical only. Keep six asset categories, including futures, in product scope; no futures tools or trade actions are exposed in this slice.

authoring_framework.selection: user-proposed FastMCP; exact stable pin used for typed Python implementation and in-memory/stdio tests

protocol_sdk.relationship: underlying official MCP Python SDK dependency; distinct from standalone fastmcp package

mcp_library.host_compatibility: ChatGPT desktop Work install and runtime not verified

data_status_axes.revision_id: provider revision identifier or null; do not infer
data_status_axes.null_reason: field-specific code; missing, blank, invalid, not-supported and not-requested are not numeric zero
data_status_axes.rights_semantics: market_rights_enabled or a local policy allow does not set rights_status=approved. This prototype emits pending because it has no purpose-specific permission reference. The gate is a conservative runtime default, not a legal ruling on individual own-account local use.

report_integration.mapping_status: candidate data-adapter mapping only; not a report body or complete R01 implementation
report_integration.tier: KIS credential/data is Pro-only by current product boundary; exact report-manifest mapping remains pending
report_integration.free_source_boundary: Free basic stock analysis uses web search and optional OpenDART; no KIS credential/account access

consumer_acknowledgment.status: accepted for partial public KR quote input only; not full deep input or live clearance

review_basis.R01_status: earlier review family label only; final user-centered function count and manifest IDs remain pending

scope_revision.screen_policy: common beginner/frequent tasks first; futures are optional staged portfolio/risk inputs

tool_output_schema.paging: none for single snapshot; page/budget contract required before history or list tools
tool_output_schema.live_and_host_status: no live KIS call; local stdio test does not prove ChatGPT Work host support

quota_evidence.status: official code assistant inventory memo; customer/account-specific limits and live behavior not verified
quota_evidence.implemented_local_limit: 1 outbound HTTP request per second per process; no retry; no cross-process/device coordinator

official_kis_personal_guidance.summary: KIS states that quote information may be used by an individual customer with a KIS account only for investment in that customer own assets, and that provision to third parties is not allowed.
official_kis_personal_guidance.implication: supports the narrow own-account, own-investment use case; does not grant third-party access or redistribution

official_kis_partner_guidance.summary: KIS distinguishes corporate third-party service providers from individual customers using their own assets; its exchange data-use agreement notice is framed for partner institutions displaying KIS market data in a partner-branded service.
official_kis_partner_guidance.implication: do not automatically impose the partner agreement path on one individual personal-use call; do not infer that a multi-user product or model-host transfer is covered

purpose_specific_rights.rights_pending_meaning: local technical deny-by-default sentinel; not an external provider rejection and not proof of a legal prohibition on the narrow personal-use scenario

purpose_states.single_user_local_view: KIS public guidance supports own-asset investment use by an individual account holder; local product execution must still preserve that purpose and account ownership
purpose_states.local_save: not implemented by this quote tool; storage duration/retention rights not established here
purpose_states.derived_analysis: not conclusively addressed by the reviewed portal pages; do not claim blanket authorization
purpose_states.third_party_provision_or_redistribution: blocked by KIS personal-use guidance; do not enable export/share
purpose_states.student_plugin_distribution_or_chat_mode: scope not resolved by the reviewed public pages; treat as a separate product/host boundary question, not a ban on a single user personal call

purpose_specific_rights.runtime_action: keep the default false until the local purpose and host data path are explicitly configured; do not require a generic written-rights approval for a user local own-account quote solely on the basis of this flag
